entities.summary: The University of Ulsan is a private university in Nam-gu, Ulsan, South Korea. The founder of the University of Ulsan is Chung Ju-yung, the founder of Hyundai Group. It was founded on February 19, 1969 as the Ulsan Institute of Technology. The university was expanded into a four-year university on March 1, 1985. The university currently has approximately 10,500 students enrolled.
